source.author: verg
source.text: Si mihi, quae quondam fuerat, quaque improbus iste exsultat fidens, si nunc foret illa iuventas, haud equidem pretio inductus pulchroque iuvenco venissem, nec dona moror.
source.text_original: Si mihi, quae quondam fuerat, quaque improbus iste / exsultat fidens, si nunc foret illa iuventas, / haud equidem pretio inductus pulchroque iuvenco / venissem, nec dona moror.'
source.text_english: If I still had that youth which once was mine, and in which that wicked man now exults, confident, I would not indeed have come, induced by any price or by a fair young steer, nor do I ask for gifts.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: si mihi quae quondam vires, vel pendere poenas Colchida iam et regis caput hic atque arma videres.
reuse.text_original: si mihi quae quondam vires, vel pendere poenas / Colchida iam et regis caput hic atque arma videres.
reuse.text_english: If I had the strength I once had, you would already see the Colchian paying the penalty, and here the king’s head and arms.
